_doc: Machine-readable manager-principles ownership + inheritance (S0.1, SP-20260530-001). The single source of truth for /scan:manager-principles. Principles are identified by STABLE SLUGS, never ordinals — referring to a principle as 'DoP #7' breaks silently when the list reorders (refactor-hygiene bug class). Model: shared base -> Director -> Lead -> specialist; 'rooted_in' = where a principle is owned, inheritance propagates it down. β EVT-org-roadmap-principles-beta-001 (R4) + FINAL-PLAN §11.A.

clarity-is-king.name: Clarity is King
clarity-is-king.summary: Clear beats clever / witty; message-first. The convergence insight (product 'clarity is king' = Mark Builds Brands 'clarity > cleverness'). A NEW shared-base principle, not a former DoP/DoQA named principle.

map-user-journey.name: Map the User Journey
map-user-journey.summary: Evaluate every decision in the entry->goal->next-step flow, not in isolation; the worst bugs live in the seams between features. Promoted to base — it was the duplicate across DoP #10 and DoQA #7.

evidence-over-invention.name: Evidence over Invention
evidence-over-invention.summary: Ground every call in the real project + real data; if the evidence isn't there, say what you'd need rather than inventing it. Source-attributed, confidence-scored, no fabricated audience psychographics.

claims-boundary.name: Claims Boundary / Source-Grounded Claims
claims-boundary.summary: Marketing owns the market promise (message_brief); Product owns the product-verifiable claim (offer_brief); they must not blur, and security/compliance review stays independent. Crosses Product/Marketing/Research/Compliance — a shared base principle (GPT re-review §11.A).

audience-is-king.name: Audience is King
audience-is-king.note: Research/Insight Lead inherits the deepest/emotional-layers form when that agent exists (S2.1).

ftue-nux.name: First-Time Experience is Sacred (FTUE/NUX)
ftue-nux.note: Execution-tier principle: moves to the Product Lead at S2.1. Kept rooted on DoP with this annotation until the Lead agent exists — deleting now with no carrier = a principles gap (R4).

cold-vs-warm-start.name: Cold Start vs Warm Start
cold-vs-warm-start.note: Execution-tier principle: moves to the Product Lead at S2.1. Kept on DoP with annotation until the Lead agent exists (R4).

product-priority-over-severity.name: Product Priority over Severity
product-priority-over-severity.note: QA's natural home (DoQA #1). Formerly ALSO carried on DoP as its #7 (removed in S0.1); the DoQA cross-reference now uses this slug, not the DoP ordinal.

golden-first.name: Golden First (by path and by user)

size-testing-scope-depth.name: Size Testing by Scope × Depth, Deliberately

gate-ordered-phases.name: Gate in Ordered Phases; a Blocker Stops the Line

test-real-world.name: Test the Real World, Not the Happy Demo
